0807.name: Unknown Name
0807.message:
Could not connect to server.
Please wait a moment and try again.

If the problem persists, please contact the Nintendo Technical Support Center as instructed in the console's instruction manual.
0807.short_description: This error is usually caused by an expired token.
0807.short_solution: Restart your console and retry the action. If that doesn't solve it, please make a support post in #support.
